q: The 'Big Five' personality traits are abbreviated as
exp: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism.

q: Which characteristic is typical of adolescents?
options: Strong influence of the peer group
exp: Adolescents often prefer peers' approval and values.

q: Kolb's experiential learning cycle includes
options: concrete experience, reflective observation, abstract conceptualisation and active experimentation
exp: These are the four phases of Kolb's cycle.

q: Dyscalculia refers to difficulty in
exp: It is a specific learning disability in arithmetic.

q: Which of the following best distinguishes guidance from counselling?
options: Guidance is broader, while counselling is a more personal, one-to-one process
exp: Counselling is one important means within the wider guidance programme.

q: Corporal punishment in schools is prohibited in India under
exp: Section 17 prohibits physical punishment and mental harassment of children.

q: Gandhi's scheme proposed free and compulsory education for the age group
exp: Basic education was designed for seven years from age 7 to 14.

q: According to Vivekananda, the essence of education lies in
exp: He said that concentration of mind is the essence of education.

q: According to Dewey, education is
options: preparation for a future life only
life itself and not merely a preparation for life
exp: Dewey stressed that education is a continual reconstruction of experience.

q: Which of the following is prohibited under Section 13 of the RTE Act?
options: Capitation fee and screening procedure for admission
exp: Section 13 bans capitation fees and screening tests for admission.

q: Maturation refers to
options: growth and changes that occur due to internal biological factors, independent of practice
changes brought about only by teaching
exp: Maturation is the unfolding of inherited biological patterns, e.g., walking when the nervous system is ready.

q: A child sees a zebra for the first time and calls it a 'striped horse'. In Piaget's terms the child is using
exp: The child fits a new object into an existing schema (horse), which is assimilation.

q: In Vygotsky's terms, a 'More Knowledgeable Other' (MKO) can be
options: a teacher, parent or even a peer who knows more about the task
exp: MKO is anyone with better understanding or skill than the learner for a given task.

q: Which stage is based on the idea 'You scratch my back and I will scratch yours'?
exp: Stage 2 involves fair exchange based on self-interest.

q: A toddler insists, 'I will do it myself', and parents encourage this. The child is likely to develop
exp: Allowing independent tasks supports autonomy in the stage of autonomy versus shame and doubt (1-3 years).

q: A dog conditioned to salivate to a bell also salivates to a similar buzzer. This is
exp: Responding to stimuli similar to the conditioned stimulus is generalisation.

q: The famous 'Bobo doll' experiment is associated with
exp: Children imitated aggressive models in the Bobo doll studies.

q: The need for achievement (n-Ach) is associated with
exp: McClelland studied the need to achieve, affiliate and gain power.

q: Guilford's Structure of Intellect model has the three dimensions of
exp: Guilford classified intellect by operations, contents and products.

q: In the brainstorming technique of Osborn, the most important rule is
options: only the best idea is accepted
criticism of ideas is withheld during idea generation
the teacher judges each idea at once
ideas must be written in silence
exp: Deferring judgment encourages many free ideas.

q: Sheldon's somatotype classification includes
exp: Sheldon related body build to temperament in these three types.

q: The best way for a teacher to deal with adolescent problems is
exp: Adolescents need empathy, counselling and guidance.

q: A slow learner generally has an IQ in the range of
exp: Slow learners fall below average but above intellectual disability.

q: Inclusive education means
options: educating all children, including those with disabilities, together in regular schools
educating disabled children in special schools only
exp: Inclusion removes barriers so all learners learn together.

q: Maintaining secrecy about the client's personal information is the principle of
exp: Confidentiality protects trust in counselling.

q: Which style of leadership in the classroom is best for developing initiative and responsibility?
exp: Lewin's studies found democratic groups showed cooperation and motivation.

q: The committee that prepared the detailed Wardha scheme was headed by
exp: The Zakir Husain Committee framed the syllabus in 1938.

q: Vivekananda strongly advocated
options: education of women and the masses
exp: He said the uplift of women and the masses was essential.

q: Which philosophy gives the greatest importance to individual freedom and choice?
exp: Existentialists stress personal responsibility and freedom.

q: Under the RTE Act the prescribed pupil-teacher ratio at the primary level is
exp: The Schedule prescribes 30:1 for primary and 35:1 for upper primary.
